segments.title: Chương 193: 0193 【Kiếm tiền nhanh hơn cướp】
segments.content:
Chapter 196: 0193 Making Money Faster Than Robbing a Bank!

Whether it was the current "Reign Under Heaven" or "Zhengtu" launching next month, the main goal of the closed beta was the mall system.

Therefore, the top-up and spending functions had to be enabled.

This was called a non-wipe closed beta; levels and equipment would be retained permanently.

New players who joined the game later and felt it was unfair could just register an account on a new server. If those old servers suffered severe player loss, they could be directly merged. In reality, the more pay-to-win whales there were on a server, the more it would attract gaming studios to set up shop.

On the ninth day after "Reign Under Heaven" went live, a serious bug was discovered: the boss of the level 30 dungeon in the Chu State could be defeated quickly and without taking damage by using a clever positioning exploit.

This resulted in the high-level players from the Chu State having an overall lead in equipment and silver taels compared to players from the other six states.

Fortunately, a single dungeon had a daily reset limit of 30 times; otherwise, Tao Chenggang would have had to order a rollback.

After a loyal fan reported the issue, the game officials immediately shut down the dungeon and conducted server maintenance the next day.

During the maintenance, a bunch of bugs were fixed.

Besides the aforementioned boss-killing positioning exploit, there were also bugs like clipping through map walls to steal treasure chests, stealing high-level resources by disengaging from combat, and infinitely farming elite mobs by disengaging from combat, etc.

Through the in-game mail system, based on the time the mail was sent, the first three players to report the bug would all receive in-game rewards.

Depending on the severity of the reported bug, the reward would be one to three months of premium VIP, as well as some rare materials and silver taels. If the players were willing to make their IDs public, they could also receive an official in-game commendation, and be recorded in the "Chronicles of Reign Under Heaven" on the official game website.

Reporters of particularly major bugs would also receive a generous cash reward and be invited to visit Bailian Technology for a tour, with all food, accommodation, and travel expenses covered.

Fu Guoqiang received this distinguished honor.

He had been playing all night and was sleeping when a friend called and woke him up, telling him to get up quickly and use the positioning exploit to farm the dungeon.

Fu Guoqiang's first reaction was, "Farm my ass!"

I've already sunk tens of thousands of yuan into this, how can I let you guys farm dungeons to get gear and catch up so quickly?

And so, he reported it.

And he was the first to report it.

Tao Chenggang personally gave him a call: "Thank you, big bro, for reporting the bug. We have temporarily shut down the level 30 dungeon in Chu State. If you're free, Brother Fu, we sincerely invite you to attend our company's annual conference..."

"Haha, no problem, it's everyone's duty to maintain game balance," Fu Guoqiang was very pleased, and then offered a suggestion for improvement, "That lottery draw of yours is too tiring on the hands. Can you add a one-hundred-pull option? My hand gets sore from clicking the ten-pull."

Tao Chenggang broke into a cold sweat. "Alright, we humbly accept your suggestion, big bro. In this maintenance update, we will add a one-hundred-pull option."

Fu Guoqiang added, "Also, when you get top-tier equipment, items, or materials, the font for the official world announcement isn't eye-catching enough. I spent a fortune to draw a divine steed, but hardly anyone noticed the official broadcast after a long time. You should add some special effects to the font, so other players can see it at a glance."

"This is an excellent suggestion. That was our oversight. Thank you for your support, big bro," Tao Chenggang accepted humbly, then asked, "Would you like to make your ID public and receive an official server-wide commendation? Reporting that bug might offend many players, so you can choose not to disclose your ID."

"Haha, make it public, of course, make it public. Go ahead and commend me, I'm not afraid!" Fu Guoqiang laughed.

After another round of thanks, Tao Chenggang finally ended the call.

Fu Guoqiang was so happy he started whistling. This game was just too satisfying; he felt fulfilled in every aspect.

Chen Guiliang received a call from Tao Chenggang and asked, "Server maintenance already?"

"There are quite a few bugs that we didn't find in the previous closed beta," Tao Chenggang said.

Chen Guiliang asked, "There aren't any bugs like item or money duplication, or infinite quest turn-ins, are there?"

Tao Chenggang said, "No. Item and money duplication bugs are now a key focus for all game companies. In the past, they were mainly exploited through network latency, but now we use serial numbers and state locks to prevent them. I'm not a tech guy, so I don't know the exact details. Haha, we'll be able to repay that 1 million we borrowed from Youke in a little while."

"It's really making a lot of money!" Chen Guiliang exclaimed.

Tao Chenggang said, "In 9 days, the total top-up amount is over 3.2 million. And this isn't even the peak period for top-ups. When the top players reach level 40 and start enhancing and upgrading all sorts of equipment, that's when the top-ups will really surge. We're also going to have nation wars in a while, which will be a huge drain and another peak for top-ups."

The person who had spent the most so far was not Fu Guoqiang from Beijing.

It was a player from Fujian, and this person was not a "spiritual shareholder" of "Reign Under Heaven."

He used to play "The Legend of Mir," then took a break from gaming for over half a year. Hearing that "Mir" had a new version, he came back. But he found that the so-called update for "Mir" had stitched-together maps and copied monsters. He was so angry he went to play on a private server with a group of old friends.

One day, while playing on the private server, a few friends discussed checking out "Reign Under Heaven." He learned about Tao Chenggang's "story" and readily agreed, joining the newly opened fourth server of "Reign Under Heaven."

In just four days, this guy topped up 50,000 yuan!

He directly bought a full year of premium VIP and used all kinds of level-boosting items non-stop. To increase his proficiency in life skills and class skills, he frantically bought out materials from the auction house. Then he poured more money into building his own family's encampment...

Moreover, this guy had terrible luck; all his lottery draws were the bare minimum pity pulls.

After he had spent over ten thousand yuan on draws, even Tao Chenggang started to feel bad and secretly ordered for him to win an orange-quality mount.

Tao Chenggang was afraid that if he didn't give this whale a grand prize soon, he would rage-quit the game.

However, the true god-tier whale had yet to make an appearance!

There were many rich people in this world; it just depended on whether you could attract them to your game.

For example, that "Zhongyuan Baotu" in "Zhengtu" spent two to three hundred thousand yuan in a single night just to send flowers to a female player in the game. Some said he was a coal baron, but when he used voice chat, he had a Wu-Yue accent and sounded very young. So, others said he was the son of a real estate developer from the Jiangsu-Zhejiang-Shanghai region.

Over on the "Zhengtu" side.

Shi Yuzhu held the reports submitted by the three play-testers. "This escort mission model is worth learning from. It can greatly increase player interaction."

In fact, he was playing it himself, having topped up over twenty thousand in "Reign Under Heaven."

This time it wasn't for fun, but to personally experience the playability of the rival game.

"Their equipment star-up system is also really well done, more refined than ours."

"And all sorts of leaderboards, with more variety than ours."

"I made a specific comparison between the lottery draws and opening treasure chests. I found that the chance of getting good items from treasure chests is much higher than from direct draws. But in 'Reign Under Heaven,' treasure chests can't be bought from the mall; they can only be obtained by killing monsters, doing quests, and through serendipitous encounters."

"Players who pay and want to open treasure chests on a large scale must first buy them from other players. And ordinary players who get chests can't open high-level ones without topping up. This strengthens the interaction between different player groups. Free-to-play users can even get Sycee, which is normally only available through top-ups, from paying players by selling high-level treasure chests."

"Even level 10 and 20 gold chests are being bought by paying players with real money because they can drop rare materials."

Shi Yuzhu studied "Reign Under Heaven" every day, then made slight adjustments to his own "Zhengtu."

The "Zhengtu" game development team was constantly expanding. It had already grown from the initial 20 people to 200 now
